correctness.rationale: The direct latitude calculation fixes the normalization. A factorized first derivative and sine-addition identities force every repeated positive real zero to a rational shared-sine node with opposite parity; exact third differentiation proves multiplicity exactly three. Rational arithmetic counts these nodes. Taylor expansion has a nonzero parameter derivative and nonzero cubic derivative; Rouché and analytic implicit functions prove three simple branches with one real and two nonreal for each small nonzero real perturbation. The executable checker numerically validates selected integrals, derivatives and roots; no finite test is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Repeated Fourier diffraction nulls for positive mixtures of two concentric uniform shells are natural and directly measurable. The finding characterizes all arithmetic exceptional radii over a continuous parameter range, quantifies the exact linear growth of multiplicity excess, and proves a sharp cube-root stability defect under radius perturbation. These are structural statements about an invariant rather than an isolated numerical example or trivial change of notation.
